protocol.target: closing return at end of next full calendar minute relative observed snapshot VWAP
protocol.tails: first (-infinity,-20], last (20,+infinity); no clipping, invented within-bin density or finite tail mean
protocol.boundary_rule: upper edges inclusive except +2 included in bullish bin12; directional aggregation exactly matches0.2
protocol.inputs: exact0.2 one-day candles/60-second book/trades/reference displacement; no added long summary after negative0.3
protocol.cohort: exact saved0.2 origins, references, primary and colour labels
protocol.loss: 18-bin cross entropy +0.25 colour cross entropy; ordinal variant adds0.5 mean17-threshold RPS
protocol.selection: lowest three-seed mean development 18-bin log loss; seed17 fixed; checkpoint early stop on development bin log loss
protocol.split: fitOct1-18; developmentOct19-21; calibrationOct22-23; inspected comparisonOct24-31,2026 UTC
protocol.calibration: scalar temperature minimized on calibration bin log loss; colour separate; direction always aggregated from calibrated bins
protocol.baselines: fit-only empirical18-bin frequencies, fit-conditional past15-minute volatility histogram; fixed fit quartiles, add-one smoothing
limitations: Perfect market probabilities cannot be certified from a finite historical sample.
Histogram is one endpoint, not an intra-candle path, touching probability, high/low distribution or15-minute fan.
Historical candle availability assumed, original receipt clocks not verified; no prospective model accuracy.
October inspected benchmark is reused for descriptive comparisons only; new confirmation remains required.
